title: Sebastian and the Cover
author: Oscar Zhou
blurb: Dominic Yarrow, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
